The Latest Report

The arch is down. The trains are running. The Kerch Bridge in 2019, before this week’s strikes. Kyiv says a road arch and span fell on the night of November 16 and 17; rail traffic, the military bulk carrier, resumed on Tuesday.

Latest Report · Tuesday, November 17, 2026

Priced, Not Settled

A bridge span fell in the Kerch Strait, three presidents prepared to sit down in Shenzhen, a Federal Reserve hike got priced as a certainty, and Texas started arguing over who holds power in January. Every visible move was cheap and reversible. The veto holders have not moved at all.

A bridge strike, a summit photograph, a futures print and an executive order are all cheap moves. Each costs the actor little, can be walked back, and exists mainly to change the price of a negotiation that has not happened yet.

Watch the veto holders, not the performers. A Republican Texas Senate, reluctant European governments and a railway timetable in Crimea have moved less this week than everyone else. They are the board.

Read the full report →

Priced, Not Settled · Morning Report

Four numbers, one argument

Everything moved. These are the numbers that show what the movement was worth.

The real yield, after inflation, stood at 2.91 percent the same day. Markets are pricing a high real cost of capital for a long time, not runaway inflation.

THE BOARDPURPOSE

Why The Board exists.

I don’t have a ton of time. It’s hard to keep up.

There are so many conflicting narratives, fed by conflicting interests. It feels hard to know what is true, and I know I’m not alone in that.

I often have questions I want answered, or things I don’t understand, that the news simply doesn’t cover. Not all of the time, but sometimes. When that happens, there is nowhere obvious to go for a straight answer.

In my ideal world, I build something useful to me. Something I enjoy reading. Because if I do, so will other people, and it will help them too.

The Board is a personal project. Everything here reflects my own views and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or representative of my employer.
